This is an invented contextual interpretation, not the actual Hohenzollern crypt floor plan or any collection object.

Do not reproduce a photograph or real museum object. No gore. The result is an AI illustration rather than documentation of a real arrangement.

Do not replicate the actual Berlin Cathedral organ design, a museum photograph or any particular artwork.

Constraints: No people, player, readable letters or numbers, scores, inscriptions, signs, logos, watermark, image border, exposed modern lighting equipment, identifiable collection art or replicated photograph. Own architectural illustration, not exact measured documentation.
